notes.title: Update # 4. Fix critical hang error
notes.content: In this update, a critical error has been fixed for the hang of the game after exiting the game in the menu and back. The player could not move, although the game was already running.

notes.title: Update # 3. Correcting comments from customers
notes.content: In this update, the operation of the sound is fixed, namely, saving the settings. Added light for the fire. Fixed some errors of light reflection. The menu is adjusted, some unnecessary buttons are removed from the menu and the pause menu.
